speaker: Sheldon
text: Godzilla claws? Not unless she destroys Tokyo. Rats. I've got it! I finally reconciled the black hole information paradox with my theory of string network condensates.

speaker: Nowitzki
text: You know you need your sleep in order for your cognitive processing to perform at optimal levels. Now come on. It's unbelievable! It's paradigm altering!

speaker: Sheldon
text: And I could not have done it without you.

speaker: Nowitzki
text: Oh, please, I just offered a little encouragement.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, you did a lot more than that. You helped me work out the masses of all fermions, and you promised my hammer toe. How can I ever repay you?

speaker: Nowitzki
text: Well, would you consider naming it the Cooper Nowitzki theorem?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, you want me to share credit? Get out.

speaker: Nowitzki
text: Oh, hey, hi. Oh, bite me. Sisters? Excuse me, Dr. Cooper. I'm Kathy O'Brien. I just finished reading your paper reconciling the black hole information paradox with your theory of string network condensates, and it just took my breath away.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Maybe when I publish it, I'll include an inhaler.

speaker: Nowitzki
text: Would you possibly have any time for me to pick your brain?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Let's see, today's Thursday. And Thursday nights I eat pizza from Giacomo's. Sausage, mushrooms, light olives.

speaker: Nowitzki
text: Great. I'll bring it to your place. I have the address.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What a nice girl. Sheldon, do you see what just happened here? Yes. I'm getting a free pizza. I'm on a roll. More pad thai, please. Sheldon, you've already had four servings. You might want to slow down a bit, buddy. One more bite.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sheldon? Sheldon, are you okay? I'm just so full.

speaker: Sheldon
text: That's it. No more Thai food.
